title: S06-01 - Back in the Hanging Office

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: An hour later, back in the treehouse, the Keystone hangs suspended above a rumbling hearth-fire, glowing soft and settled. The Custodian, older now, the night's work plain in her voice, folds into an over-stuffed chair. "You fought hard. I'm not surprised. Emeris doesn't send just anyone." There is hot food, a warm bath waiting, and for the first time in days, nowhere you need to be. She looks at each of you like she is memorizing you. "Before you go," she says, "let's talk about what happened out there, and what you'll do with it."

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Rest, receive your due, and reckon with the choice you made.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: The Keystone rests above the hearth while the Custodian thanks the party.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Use triumphant, bittersweet, pyrrhic, or tragic tone from ritual_outcome and custodian_fate.
If package_status=lost somehow reached here, frame this as an alternate close and flag the normal reward text as changed.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "This is the good part. The fire, the food, the old faerie who is alive because of you. Level up, collect what you earned, and let the report choice sit in the room."
